title.original: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval: Bridging Tools and Agents for Scalable LLM Multi-Agent Systems
title.zh: 工具到代理检索：可扩展LLM多代理系统的桥接工具和代理
title.en: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval: Bridging Tools and Agents for Scalable LLM Multi-Agent Systems

inclusion_reason.zh: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval 提供双层向量索引和工具—Agent 元数据图，可作为大规模 MCP 路由层直接集成。
inclusion_reason.en: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval provides a two-level vector index and tool-agent metadata graph that can be integrated as a large-scale MCP routing layer.

abstract.zh: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval 将工具与其父 Agent 映射到同一向量空间，通过元数据边从细粒度工具能力反向路由到可执行 Agent。
abstract.en: Tool-to-Agent Retrieval embeds tools and their parent agents in one vector space, using metadata edges to route from fine-grained capabilities back to executable agents.

problem.zh: 只检索粗粒度 Agent 描述会把数百个工具的差异压平，尤其在 MCP Server 聚合后造成上下文稀释和错误路由。
problem.en: Retrieving only coarse agent descriptions collapses distinctions among hundreds of tools, causing context dilution and poor routing when MCP servers are aggregated.

approach.zh: 框架分别嵌入工具和 Agent，并显式保存归属关系，使查询既可命中具体工具，也可沿关系提升到负责该工具的 Agent。
approach.en: The framework embeds tools and agents separately and records ownership links, so queries can hit exact tools and traverse metadata to the responsible agent.

system_design.zh: 索引层保存双层向量与工具—Agent 图，检索层执行工具级或 Agent 级搜索，路由层聚合分数后选择子 Agent/MCP 集合。
system_design.en: An index stores two-level vectors and a tool-agent graph; retrieval searches either level, and routing aggregates scores to choose sub-agents and MCP sets.

key_results.zh: 在 LiveMCPBench 和多种嵌入模型上，细粒度表示持续改善前列召回与排序质量，证明工具描述不应被压缩进单一 Agent 摘要。
key_results.en: Across LiveMCPBench and multiple embeddings, fine-grained representation consistently improves top-rank recall and ranking quality, showing that tools should not be collapsed into one agent summary.

limitations.zh: 评测主要衡量离线检索而非端到端任务成功；元数据质量、工具版本漂移和大规模在线索引维护尚未得到验证。
limitations.en: Evaluation emphasizes offline retrieval rather than end-to-end task success; metadata quality, tool-version drift, and online index maintenance at scale remain untested.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
